text:
Priya Rao: Heads-up team 1: Aisha Rahman (frontend infra candidate) final loop scheduled for Tue May 12. Candidate is based in CET (GMT+1) and prefers morning slots. This will be a hybrid loop: candidate remote, most panelists in-office. Need: visitor parking, loaner laptop (Linux preferred), nut-free lunch, elevator access note, and Zoom fallback. Can @Ben Carter and @Alex Kim confirm?

Ben Carter: I can do 09:30-12:00 CET. I'll take the culture + frontend perf slot. Can someone add a senior product eng? :white_check_mark:

Alex Kim: I'm free for 09:30-12:00 CET. I can cover infra + observability. Quick flag1: our usual interview room (SF-Oak-1) is blocked for a team offsite that morning. Evelyn, can you book another room?

Evelyn Park: Noted. Checking alternate rooms now. SF-Elm-3 is free until 13:00 — I'll tentatively reserve it and request an accessible table by the elevator. Parking: I'll reserve one visitor spot at 4thSt Lot (plate hold under "Aisha Rahman"). Lunch: nut-free boxed lunches (2 vegan, 2 omnivore, 1 dairy-free).

Priya Rao: Thanks. Candidate prefers to start at 09:15 CET and finish by 12:30 CET. Can we shift to 09:15-12:30 CET? Include 15-min buffer before panel for check-in and tech setup. Evelyn, please update the scheduling sheet.

Evelyn Park: Updated schedule row 88 to 2026-05-12 09:15-12:30 CET. Booking SF-Elm-3 confirmed. Added elevator accessibility note to the invite.

People Ops Bot: Calendar invites created for tentative slot 2026-05-12 09:15 CET -> 12:30 CET. Zoom link + phone backup included. RSVP statuses: Ben (accepted), Alex (accepted), Product (pending), Hiring Mgr (pending).

Alex Kim: I'll need a loaner ThinkPad with Ubuntu image and USB-C charger. @Device Ops can you confirm availability?

Device Ops: Loaner request submitted (ticket #DO-4891). Hold for pickup at front desk on 2026-05-12 between 08:45-09:10. Laptop image will have corp VPN + browser profile pre-installed.

Ben Carter: I'll prep 2 short whiteboard prompts and upload a 1-pager to Drive (link: https://drive.redwood/recruiting/aisha_rahman). Also adding a small take-home perf exercise (optional) to send after loop.

Priya Rao: Candidate arrival instructions to include elevator access, front desk name, and parking directions. Please do not include door codes in calendar; send secure email with arrival PIN instead. Draft snippet below for secure email: 
```
Office: Redwood HQ, 123 Market St, 3rd floor (Elm)
Front desk: Please check in as "Aisha Rahman"
Visitor parking: 4th St Lot, spot reserved under name
Accessibility: Elevator available; accessible table reserved in SF-Elm-3
Loaner pickup: Front desk between 08:45-09:10 (bring ID)
Dietary: Nut-free lunches will be provided
Remote fallback: Zoom link in calendar; phone backup will be shared
```

People Ops Bot: Candidate secure email scheduled for 2026-05-11 09:00 CET. Logistics email will contain travel reimbursement form, pickup instructions for the loaner device, parking photo requirements, and accessibility note.

Evelyn Park: Filed parking reservation and catering order. Loaner ticket queued. I'll send the secure arrival PIN and final logistics at scheduled time and copy the interview panel. Closing ops items unless anyone needs changes. :white_check_mark:

Ben Carter: All set from my side. Will upload materials by EOD Fri.

Alex Kim: Same here. Thanks everyone!
